integrity: The proof reconstructs the published view recursion, factors arbitrary suffixes as union-linear contributor maps, and proves necessity using a coordinate-equality epistemic model that separates distinct intersection-index sets. The primary open-access paper was inspected at the view and resolution definitions, Lemma 3.6, the semantics, and the conclusion's explicit redundancy question. Pairwise gossip literature was checked for stronger covering results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns model-independent preservation of the final current accessibility relations, not full history-sensitive semantic equivalence. Equal current views need not imply indistinguishability of histories. The n(n-1) compression bound is general but is not claimed to be sharp.
title: Exact forward-backward redundancy test for asynchronous resolutions
